requirements.text: Real-time notifications for transactions, including amount, merchant name, and remaining balance, delivered within five seconds of the transaction being authorized.
An instant card freezing and unfreezing feature that allows users to block and restore access to their card through an intuitive interface within the app.
Automated monthly spending breakdowns that categorize expenses and provide users the ability to set personalized budgets with alerts for approaching limits.
Visualizations like graphs or charts to show spending trends over time.
System must comply with PSD2's Strong Customer Authentication requirements.
System must comply with GDPR regulations, ensuring data privacy by storing data within the EEA.
Integrate new features with the existing core banking system without requiring changes to the mainframe.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app during the transition.
